title: Mower Mayhem
tagline: Ten walled lawns, one battery mower and a garden full of wildlife you must never touch.
blurb: Ten walled lawns, one battery mower and a garden full of wildlife you must never touch. Mow every stripe, zap the weeds with your trimmer, steer round the flower beds and roll onto the dock before the power dies. Finish Lawn 10 for the victory card and a high score to beat.

review.verdict: Just keep the trimmer away from the hedgehogs.

quote.text: The tunes are a treat, and M shuts them up if the neighbours complain

credits.name: Baz Pocket, Prue Fairley and Norm Crabtree for INK & PAPER
